description: This file defines a function called `json_tokenize` that processes a JSON string to produce a list of tokens. It uses regular expressions to match JSON components and replaces certain characters to handle particular syntax constraints, especially for brackets. The function outputs a token list suitable for parsing JSON in CMake scripts.

methods.name: json_tokenize
methods.description: Tokenizes a JSON string by matching regex patterns and handling brackets, replacing certain characters to facilitate parsing.
